analysis_type: static PE export and call-site review

observed_abi.XMemAllocatePhysicalPages: BOOL WINAPI (UINT64 flags, SIZE_T* in_out_page_count, UINT64* page_token_array)
observed_abi.XMemMapPhysicalPages: void* WINAPI (void* reserved_address, SIZE_T page_count, UINT64* page_token_array)

reference_behavior.allocation: The title passes a flags value of 0x20400000 and an in/out count. The reference export issues NtManagePartition operation 0x1500b8 and fills 64-bit page tokens.
reference_behavior.mapping: The reference export forwards address, count, and token array to NtMapUserPhysicalPages at reference IAT RVA 0x93e8. A null token array is forwarded for unmapping. The title shifts allocation byte sizes right by 16 to form the page count.
reference_behavior.release: The title passes page count in RCX and token-array pointer in RDX. The reference export releases tokens through NtManagePartition operation 0x1500bc.
reference_behavior.page_size_basis: Frosty call-site arithmetic uses byte_size >> 16; Microsoft DirectStorage documentation also describes XMem physical pages as 64 KB pages.

tuxbox_provider.implementation: The provider owns each token, accepts the 0x20400000 allocation profile and maps a 64 KiB CPU page per token. Unmapping saves the bytes and decommits the host range. Remapping restores bytes in the requested token order.
limitations: CPU-only mapping with at most one active mapping per token
Xbox partition allocation and GPU-visible backing remain unimplemented
The packaged control stops during xbthunk initialization on both Proton builds.
